title: Parts of Speech
content:
Definition

English: Parts of speech are the categories of words based on their function in a sentence.
Hindi: Parts of speech shabdon ke wo varg hote hain jo vakya mein unke karya ke adhaar par banaye jate hain.

There are eight main parts: Noun, Pronoun, Verb, Adjective, Adverb, Preposition, Conjunction, Interjection.
Aath mukhya prakar hote hain: Sangya, Sarvanam, Kriya, Visheshan, Kriya Visheshan, Sambandh Suchak, Samuchchay Bodhak, Vismayadibodhak.

Example: Wow! The cat quickly jumped on the table.
Hindi: Arre! Billi jaldi se mez par koodi.

title: Noun
content:
Definition

English: A noun is a word that names a person, place, thing, or idea.
Hindi: Sangya ek aisa shabd hai jo kisi vyakti, sthan, vastu, ya vichar ka naam batata hai.

Use

Used as the subject or object in a sentence.
Vakya mein karta ya karma ke roop mein prayog hota hai.

Example: The dog barked at the stranger.
Hindi: Kutta ajnabi par bhounka.

title: Pronoun
content:
Definition

English: A pronoun is a word used in place of a noun to avoid repetition.
Hindi: Sarvanam ek aisa shabd hai jo sangya ke sthan par dohraav se bachne ke liye prayog hota hai.

Use

Replaces nouns to make sentences less repetitive.
Sangya ke dohraav ko kam karne ke liye.

Example: She is reading her book.
Hindi: Woh apni kitaab padh rahi hai.

title: Verb
content:
Definition

English: A verb expresses an action, occurrence, or state of being.
Hindi: Kriya ek aisa shabd hai jo karya, ghatna, ya sthiti ko vyakt karta hai.

Use

Shows what the subject does or is.
Karta kya karta hai ya kaisa hai yeh batata hai.

Example: They run every morning.
Hindi: Ve har subah daudte hain.

title: Adjective
content:
Definition

English: An adjective describes or modifies a noun, indicating its quality, quantity, or extent.
Hindi: Visheshan ek shabd hai jo sangya ka varnan ya sanshodhan karta hai, uski gunvatta, sankhya, ya pariman ko batata hai.

Use

Adds detail to nouns.
Sangya mein vivaran jodta hai.

Example: The beautiful garden bloomed.
Hindi: Sundar baagh khila.

title: Adverb
content:
Definition

English: An adverb modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb, indicating manner, time, place, or degree.
Hindi: Kriya visheshan ek shabd hai jo kriya, visheshan, ya doosre kriya visheshan ko sanshodhit karta hai, tareeka, samay, sthan, ya pariman batata hai.

Use

Describes how, when, where, or to what extent an action occurs.
Karya kaise, kab, kahan, ya kis had tak hota hai yeh batata hai.

Example: She sings beautifully.
Hindi: Woh sundar roop se gaati hai.

title: Preposition
content:
Definition

English: A preposition shows the relationship of a noun or pronoun to another word.
Hindi: Sambandh suchak ek shabd hai jo sangya ya sarvanam ka doosre shabd se sambandh batata hai.

Use

Indicates location, time, or direction.
Sthan, samay, ya disha batata hai.

Example: The book is on the table.
Hindi: Kitaab mez par hai.

title: Conjunction
content:
Definition

English: A conjunction connects words, phrases, or clauses.
Hindi: Samuchchay bodhak ek shabd hai jo shabd, vakyansh, ya vakya ko jodta hai.

Use

Joins parts of a sentence to show relationships.
Vakya ke bhagon ko jodkar sambandh batata hai.

Example: I wanted to go, but it was raining.
Hindi: Main jaana chahta tha, lekin baarish ho rahi thi.

title: Interjection
content:
Definition

English: An interjection is a word or phrase that expresses sudden emotion or reaction.
Hindi: Vismayadibodhak ek shabd ya vakyansh hai jo achanak bhavna ya prativikriya vyakt karta hai.

Use

Used to express feelings like surprise, joy, or pain.
Bhavna jaise ashcharya, khushi, ya dard vyakt karne ke liye.

Example: Ouch! That hurt.
Hindi: Aah! Yeh dardnak hai.
